description: Lists the Node source payload of a checkout: the files package.json declares plus package.json, and inside a Git repository only the tracked and untracked non-ignored ones. The release builder and the checkout drift row use this one rule (packages/distribution/rust/src/source_payload.rs); it reads and writes nothing else.

answer.files: sorted in JavaScript's default string order, each once

exits.1: source-payload-refused: a declared entry that is absolute, escapes the root, is the root itself, is missing or is a link; an unreadable package.json; a failed Git read
exits.2: usage: a missing root, a missing --protocol value, an unknown or extra argument
